own_solution.law: Normal-incidence acoustic transmission with Z = rho c; I_t = 4 Z1 Z2/(Z1+Z2)^2 I_i; p_t = sqrt(2 Z2 I_t)
assumptions: continuity of pressure and normal velocity

defect_reasons.other: The R wiring adds the further intensity to the incident wave's intensity, which presumes it is part of the same plane wave (or that a single pressure amplitude is defined for the combined field); the sentences do not say so.

notes: All certified answers agree with my computation: base 6.2842 Pa; I = 0.015, 0.018, 0.021 W/m^2 give 7.0260, 7.6966, 8.3133 Pa. The authors' relations (intensity transmission then p = sqrt(2 Z2 I_t)) are equivalent to my pressure-transmission route. Frequency cancels via Z = rho*lambda*f = rho*c, consistent with my pass-1 C. Minimal pairs TA783/TCC99 and TEFDB/T9B4F share 0.006 W/m^2 and differ only in attachment; TF89B and TBD48 are declared numeral-free twins. No disagreement with pass 1.
